description: NVIDIA's NVFP4 (ModelOpt) quantization of Google Gemma 4 26B-A4B IT on one Spark with vLLM v0.25.1 plus upstream's patched gemma4.py (ModelOpt lm_head tying): 262144-token context, fp8 KV cache, 18 concurrent sequences, MTP speculative decoding (1 token) with Google's gemma-4-26B-A4B-it-assistant, one image per prompt, thinking on by default, Gemma 4 reasoning and tool-call parsers. Basis: MiaAI-Lab's 18-concurrency start.sh (no licence file upstream; gemma4.py keeps vLLM's Apache-2.0 header). Upstream runs the mutable vllm-openai:nightly of July 2026; this recipe pins v0.25.1, whose gemma4.py differs from the patch by 13 lines. v0.25.1 also carries vLLM #43957, which stops sharing the target embedding with the MTP assistant, so this MoE model fails engine initialization (vLLM issue #47794: a and b must have same reduction dim, [s47, 3840] X [5632, 1024]); the image applies the exact upstream fix, vLLM PR #47953 (released in v0.27.0). Upstream's 2026-07-05 nightly predates the regression. Model and assistant are under Google's Gemma terms (recorded as information). Upstream throughput figures (about 282 tok/s at 18 sessions) are its claims; Vonk physical Spark acceptance is pending. Security note: upstream allows the server to fetch images from any URL (--allowed-media-domains *). Anyone who can send requests to this endpoint can make the Spark fetch arbitrary URLs, including addresses on your local network. Thinking default is chosen per request (chat template kwargs or sampling parameters), not as a recipe option; server default: enable_thinking true (upstream default); reasoning is returned via the gemma4 parser. Memory follows the creator's settings: gpu-memory-utilization 0.70, as in MiaAI-Lab's start.sh at 39e94192 (line 99). The steady per-node peak is 0.70 x 130,663,231,488-byte unified memory plus 8 GB for CUDA context, FlashInfer workspace, auxiliary heads and CPU/mmap buffers (a speculative draft is profiled inside the utilization budget); the reserve is 8 GB, and admission keeps the platform memory floor free beside the peak.
title: Gemma 4 26B-A4B NVFP4 MTP 18-session vLLM single Spark (Mia)
